run_eval_with_lm_harness: run the LM evaluation harness on a consolidated model checkpoint using eval.py with a config file
run_eval_ppl_on_jsonl: run perplexity evaluation on a JSONL file using eval_ppl with a model and tokenizer
run_eval_on_validation_sources: run validation evaluation on JSONL sources using eval_on_val with a generator and validation args
create_eval_harness_lm_wrapper: create an EvalHarnessLM wrapper around a PackedCausalTransformerGenerator for lm-eval harness compatibility
launch_eval_from_config: launch a full evaluation pipeline from an EvalArgs config including harness, PPL, and validation
